scenarios.task: Tension and torque suspension cables on a canopy walkway span above a cloud-forest ravine.
hazards: Wet, mossy steel creating slip hazards
Load shift if cable tension is uneven
steps: Attend toolbox talk and confirm rescue plan.
Inspect turnbuckles, thimbles and anchor points for corrosion.
Rig load line and verify torque wrench calibration.
Tension both cables incrementally, alternating sides.
Check sag with surveyor's level against spec.
Torque-lock all fittings and apply corrosion-resistant coating.
Log final tension readings for the Progress Tracker.

rubric.pass_if: Apprentice stays 100% tied off above 6 feet
Cable tensions within 5% of each other at completion
All locknuts torqued and logged before leaving span
Uses standardized hand signals with partner at all times

scenarios.robot_role: Shuttles tensioning tools and cable hardware across muddy trail sections to the ravine anchor point.

scenarios.task: Install EMT conduit and pulls circuits for sensor outlets in the Research Synthesis Lab, keeping dust out of electronics.
steps: Lock out and tag out the feeder breaker.
Verify zero energy with a meter.
Measure, cut and ream conduit runs along wall route.
Bend offsets with hand bender; deburr all ends.
Secure straps within code spacing; bond ground continuity.
Pull conductors with fish tape; terminate at outlets.
Remove locks, test circuits and record readings.

rubric.pass_if: Applies and verifies lockout before any panel contact
Conduit runs plumb, strapped and fully deburred
Continuity verified and documented before energizing
No metal filings or dust left near lab equipment

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and rotates conduit stock for cutting and reaming at bench height.

scenarios.task: Frame and deck a viewing platform for the Progress Observatory on a steep cloud-forest slope.
hazards: Buried sensor lines in the work zone
steps: Confirm survey stakes and locate marked sensor lines before digging.
Set post bases on poured footings; check plumb both ways.
Cut ledgers and joists to layout; crown all joists up.
Fasten hardware with hot-dip galvanized hangers and nails.
Lay decking with gaps for rainwater drainage.
Install guardrail posts and midrails before crew leaves deck.
Sweep site and stage offcuts for removal.

rubric.pass_if: Joist spacing and deck squareness within 1/4 inch over 12 feet
Calls for locate sheet and hand-digs near marked lines
Guardrails complete before open deck edges are left unattended
Drainage gaps and galvanized hardware used throughout

scenarios.robot_role: Carries fasteners and small tools up slope trails too muddy for the cart.

scenarios.task: Fabricate and hang CPVC and copper lines feeding the rainwater cistern serving Charter Hall restrooms.
hazards: Solvent cement vapors in enclosed spaces
Soldering burns and torch fire risk near wood framing
steps: Isolate supply and drain existing lines.
Measure and cut pipe; dry-fit the full run first.
Solvent-weld CPVC with ventilation running; label cure times.
Sweat copper joints with fire watch and heat shield.
Hang runs with insulated clamps at proper spacing.
Pressure-test to 1.5x working pressure and hold 30 minutes.
Flush, chlorinate potable lines and sign off.

rubric.pass_if: Zero leaks on 30-minute pressure test
Exhaust fan running and respirator worn during solvent work
Fire extinguisher and shield in place for all torch work
Clamps spaced per spec with no sag

scenarios.task: Haul gravel and timber up a narrow, wet mountain road to a walkway staging area without blocking the single lane.
hazards: Pedestrians and researchers on the road
steps: Perform pre-trip inspection; check brakes and load binders.
Confirm staging coordinates with Task Router dispatch.
Walk the last 200 meters for shoulder condition and overhead clearance.
Flag blind curves with a spotter before proceeding.
Spot the truck at staging; chock wheels on grade.
Unload with tag lines; keep no one under suspended loads.
Secure tarps for return and report road hazards.

rubric.pass_if: Documented inspection completed before moving
Blind curves flagged every trip, no exceptions
Binders and tarps checked after unloading
No blocking of researcher access or drainage ditches

scenarios.robot_role: Walks the route ahead to map washouts, soft shoulders and downed limbs before the truck climbs.

scenarios.task: Strip failing finish and apply slip-resistant marine coating to boardwalk planks around the Proposal Forum deck.
hazards: Lead or unknown coatings on old planks
steps: Test old coating for lead; set up containment if positive.
Post closure signage and barricade alternate route.
Strip failed finish; collect debris in sealed bags.
Wash with degreaser; moisture-test planks to spec.
Apply marine primer within recoat window.
Broadcast anti-slip aggregate into wet topcoat.
Cure-check before reopening to foot traffic.

rubric.pass_if: All stripper debris captured and bagged, none to soil
Moisture readings meet spec before coating
Aggregate broadcast on every plank before tack-over
Signage removed only after cure verified

scenarios.task: Set up off-grid solar battery bank and inverter cabinet powering Progress Observatory instruments.
steps: Mount battery rack on elevated platform above splash zone.
Torque battery terminals with insulated tools; never bridge poles.
Connect cells per series diagram; verify polarity each step.
Ground rack and cabinet; install hydrogen vent fan.
Land DC feeds at inverter with lockout on PV strings.
Program charge limits; log commissioning data.
Post warning labels and one-line diagram inside door.

rubric.pass_if: Continuity and polarity verified after every connection
Vent fan operational before first charge cycle
Rack and cabinet grounds verified to spec
Labels and one-line diagram posted before close-up

scenarios.robot_role: Presents and positions batteries at rack height with torque-monitored terminal driving.
